This repository is for maintaining a checklist of the butterflies of Alaska in Darwin Core format based on the *Butterflies of Alaska* [@PhilipFerris2026].

The structure of the checklist follows guidance of @GBIF2017. The [archive/checklist.csv](blob/main/archive/taxon.csv) table currently includes information from the Darwin Core

- taxon (<https://rs.gbif.org/core/dwc_taxon_2025-07-10.xml>),
- species distribution (<https://rs.gbif.org/extension/gbif/1.0/distribution_2022-02-02.xml>), and
- vernacular names (<https://rs.gbif.org/extension/gbif/1.0/vernacularname.xml>)

extensions. Terms and controlled vocabularies follow @DarwinCoreMaintenanceGroup2026.
